name: Sarishne
notes: A Rakshasa guardian, remembered as a concealed witness to the original Shadow Pact and separately in an account of a later gate disturbance. The sources do not establish formal participation in the pact. Gagdji is her partner. The draft last-attendance account names her and Gagdji as witnesses and leaves the date and place open. Tendua guardianship is an independent part of her testimony.
